name: vlm_membrane_blebbing_severity
description: Visually assesses the degree of plasma membrane blebbing (irregular bulges) visible in the Actin channel. Blebbing is a key morphological feature distinguishing apoptosis and pyroptosis from healthy cells.
method_rationale: Blebbing involves complex, irregular boundary deformations that are difficult to quantify with simple shape metrics but are visually distinct to a VLM.
